subject: Request: Additional insured endorsement wording + COI delivery for BrightWave POC
messages:
From: Lina Torres <procurement@brightwavehealth.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: Miguel Santos <broker@shieldassure.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Insurance endorsement and COI for POC

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — BrightWave is excited to move the POC forward. Our procurement team needs a couple items to complete internal approvals before we can sign: 

- A sample Certificate of Insurance showing the proposed limits and carriers for the Redwood account supporting the POC (we typically ask for GL limits of $2M/$4M and Cyber limits of $2M; please confirm).
- An Additional Insured endorsement naming "BrightWave Health, Inc., its officers, directors and affiliates" as Additional Insured on the GL policy (or equivalent wording).
- Confirmation whether Redwood can provide a waiver of subrogation in favor of BrightWave.

Can you also confirm the exact legal entity name we should use on the endorsement and whether you require any special form (CG 20 10 or equivalent)? We need these artifacts to route to legal/procurement — ideal delivery by EOD Mon 5/29.

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
BrightWave Health
procurement@brightwavehealth.com

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear list and for moving quickly. Looping Legal (Kimberly) and Sales (Aditya, Vivek) to scope the ask. A few quick clarifying items so we can deliver the right artifacts: 

1) Legal entity: can you confirm if the purchasing entity is exactly "BrightWave Health, Inc." or a subsidiary (billing/legal name)?
2) Limits: we can provide GL limits at $2M/$4M and Cyber at $2M; is evidence of carriers (A.M. Best >= A-) required?
3) Form: is BrightWave requiring ISO CG 20 10 specifically, or is equivalent endorsement language acceptable?

Attaching a COI template and the Order Form you sent (see attached). Kimberly — can you review and propose endorsement language we can present to the broker? Aditya/Vivek — heads up that procurement may request a DocuSign for the Order Form once insurance is confirmed.

I’ll consolidate responses and send a final packet for signature by EOB Mon 5/29 if we have the information.

Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Insurance endorsement and COI for POC

Hi team — quick legal take. We can accommodate BrightWave's request with the following constraints and suggested language: 

- Limits: Acceptable to confirm GL 2M/4M and Cyber 2M. If BrightWave requires carrier crediting, please specify AM Best minimum; otherwise we will provide our standard carriers.
- Additional Insured: Proposed endorsement wording (can be provided as an endorsement form or as an equivalent insurer letter):

  "The insurer agrees to endorse the policy to name as an Additional Insured: BrightWave Health, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and affiliated entities, but only with respect to liability arising out of Redwood Inference's operations or services under the Agreement."

- Waiver of Subrogation: We generally approve a waiver of subrogation for Workers' Compensation; for GL/Cyber we require underwriter sign-off. Please advise if BrightWave will accept waiver limited to WC.

- Entity name: please confirm exact legal entity for endorsement (Lina).

I attached a short endorsement draft for the broker to review — Miguel, please confirm insurer acceptance and whether CG 20 10 is needed or an equivalent will do. If BrightWave insists on a specific ISO form, that can introduce insurer lead time.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Miguel Santos <broker@shieldassure.com>

Cc: Lina Torres <procurement@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 24 May 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Insurance endorsement and COI for POC

Thanks for the details. Confirming items from the broker side: 

- BrightWave entity: confirmed as "BrightWave Health, Inc." — legal will accept that.
- CG 20 10: Insurer is comfortable endorsing via CG 20 10 or equivalent wording; either will be fine.
- Waiver of Subrogation: carrier requires written request; for GL it’s unusual but we can request. If BrightWave will accept waiver limited to WC, that’s the fastest route.

I attached a filled COI template with placeholder limits; once you sign off we’ll work with carrier to issue a COI and endorsement. Expected lead time for physical endorsement depends on carrier — typically 2-3 business days after insurer agrees.

Miguel Santos

Thanks, everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) BrightWave legal confirmed the purchasing entity: BrightWave Health, Inc. (thanks Lina).
2) Redwood will provide a draft COI showing GL limits $2M/$4M and Cyber $2M and will request the additional insured endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) naming BrightWave Health, Inc.
3) Waiver of Subrogation: we will request WC waiver and a carrier review for GL waiver; Miguel will flag any carrier objections.
4) Timeline: Miguel estimates 2-3 business days after insurer sign-off. We will aim to deliver the COI and endorsement confirmation by EOB Mon 5/29; if carrier timing slips we’ll escalate.
5) Contracts: Aditya/Vivek — please prepare the DocuSign-ready Order Form once we have final confirmation from Miguel.

Lina — is there a preferred DocuSign routing or contact we should use on your side? Also, if you need a signed MSA redline before the PO, flag that and we’ll prioritize Legal.

I’ll follow up with the COI/endorsement packet once I have the insurer deliverables.

Best,
